card.title: Waiting for the Bad News
card.instruction: Treat pauses, changes, and uncertainty as signs that rejection or loss is approaching, then prepare yourself before it arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You paused when I asked about Saturday. Should I collect my things from your flat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was swallowing tea. I'm taking you to dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Somewhere public. I'll bring tissues that fit in my sleeve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at home. I'm cooking your favourite.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll bring containers. You shouldn't have my leftovers haunting the fridge afterwards.
